records.description: TaggIoT combines battery-free smart tags, gateways, and an analytics platform to track assets, shipments, and carbon data in real time. It looks like a real logistics product, but the hardware and enterprise deployment model make it a weaker Product Hunt fit.

records.name: onBeacon
records.tagline: Your AI Growth PM, on call 24/7
records.description: onBeacon analyzes your product flows against 230+ behavioral science principles and tells you exactly what to change to boost engagement and stop users from churning — with ready-to-test A/B variants delivered in minutes, not weeks.

records.name: Novo AI
records.tagline: Insurance claims automation for ops teams
records.description: Novo AI automates insurance workflows like claims intake, review, and downstream operations for insurers and related operations teams.

records.name: U-Reg Pte. Ltd.
records.tagline: Compliance platform for regulated finance teams
records.description: U-Reg gives financial institutions a central platform for regulatory workflows, documentation, and compliance controls across changing requirements.

records.name: ThinkMD
records.tagline: Clinical assessment app for frontline health workers
records.description: ThinkMD gives health workers a mobile assessment tool that scores symptoms, surfaces risks, and recommends next steps online or offline.

records.name: Betterteem
records.tagline: AI attrition forecasting for workforce teams
records.description: Betterteem predicts employee attrition risk, quantifies financial exposure, and recommends interventions so large organizations can protect retention and operational stability.

records.name: Quest
records.tagline: Marketplace for errands, gigs, and on-demand help
records.description: Quest is a mobile marketplace for hiring people for errands, deliveries, staffing, and content work, with an AI assistant that helps route requests. It looks live, but the model is services-heavy and locally operational.

records.name: Hyarks
records.tagline: The Ocean Marketplace for Commercial Fishing
records.description: Tuna fishing fleets alone burn over US$2Bn in fuel, and 90% of that is searching, not fishing. Hyarks builds and deploy multidomain robotic ships to search, find and sell catches in Hyarks ocean market place. Fishing fleets pay to catch, not to search

records.name: Renight
records.tagline: Sleep app for better rest and routines
records.description: Munice builds Renight, a consumer sleep app with personalized, science-backed guidance to help people improve sleep quality and nighttime habits.

records.name: Cookie Lang, Inc.
records.tagline: Roleplay video app for language learners
records.description: Cookie Lang helps language learners practice conversations through short roleplay video scenarios across multiple languages.

records.name: HeyMax
records.tagline: Stripe for miles - one API, 30+ airlines and hotels
records.description: HeyMax is the Stripe for travel miles. Max Miles is a universal loyalty currency that transfers from 1:1 to 30+ airlines and hotels — no fees, no expiry. Any business can plug in via one API to give the world's best travel rewards. Plus Max, our AI agent, finds and books the best award seats across 30 airlines for you.

records.name: Wubble.ai
records.tagline: Ethical AI audio studio for music, voices, and sound effects
records.description: Wubble empowers creators generate royalty-free music, AI voiceovers, and sound effects from prompts. It packages ethically created audio generation into a browser tool for fast, commercial-ready production.

records.name: Airbag
records.tagline: Reward safer fleet driving with AI insights
records.description: Airbag helps fleet operators analyze driving behavior, coach drivers, and reward safe habits with points and incentives. It helps reduce accidents, improve retention, and lower fuel and operating costs across transport fleets.

records.name: Xena Intelligence
records.tagline: Amazon growth analytics for CPG brands
records.description: XENA Intelligence helps CPG brands manage Amazon growth with account services, brand analytics, and shopper insight tools like Xenalytics, Foresight, and BrandVoice.

records.name: Mimin
records.tagline: Chat and voice AI platform for customer support
records.description: Mimin unifies chat AI, voice AI, inbox, ticketing, and operational workflows so businesses can handle customer conversations across channels with full context from first message to resolution.

records.name: Infiuss Health
records.tagline: Digital patient twins for clinical research
records.description: Infiuss models digital patient twins to simulate trial outcomes, unify health data, and support clinical research planning and precision medicine workflows.

records.name: Acceler8
records.tagline: AI workforce intelligence for succession planning
records.description: Acceler8 helps enterprises assess talent readiness, map succession options, and make faster workforce planning decisions with AI-driven workforce intelligence.

records.name: Blind Creator
records.tagline: Modular influencer marketing stack for agencies
records.description: Blind Creator gives influencer marketing agencies modular tools for creator discovery, CRM, campaign management, reporting, and automation, so teams can scale without buying an oversized all-in-one suite.

records.name: Rey Assurance
records.tagline: Digital health app for care and insurance workflows
records.description: Rey combines doctor chat, health programs, and insurance-facing tools in one Indonesian health platform for individuals, employers, and insurers.

records.name: GreenFi Ai
records.tagline: ESG compliance software for finance teams
records.description: GreenFi helps finance and supply-chain teams manage ESG due diligence, carbon data, and sustainability compliance with AI-assisted workflows and reporting tools.

records.name: Needle AI, Inc.
records.tagline: AI marketing team for ecommerce brands
records.description: Needle combines AI and human review to plan campaigns, create ad and email assets, and launch growth work for ecommerce brands that would otherwise hire an agency.

records.name: Agricore
records.tagline: Financial infrastructure for verifiable agricultural assets
records.description: AgriCore is a financial and risk infrastructure platform for agriculture that makes livestock, land, and crops verifiable, insurable, and financeable. Using AI-driven biometric identification for livestock and geospatial intelligence for land and crops, it enables insurers, banks, and financial institutions to underwrite, lend, and serve farmers more efficiently across underserved markets.

records.name: MarkIt
records.tagline: Trade compliance infrastructure for import workflows
records.description: MarkIt helps enterprises manage classification, audit trails, and trade compliance governance across legal, procurement, and logistics workflows. it's what flexport promised, before becoming a normal customs broker / forwarder.

records.name: MUI-Robotics
records.tagline: Artificial sensing systems for robots
records.description: MUI-Robotics develops robotic sensing instruments built around artificial sense technology. Its products focus on giving robots compact sensing hardware for perception, tracking, and automation workflows.

records.name: VueMotion
records.tagline: AI movement analysis for athlete performance
records.description: VueMotion is an AI Movement Intelligence platform that turns everyday smartphone video into validated biomechanical insights. With just a phone, tripod and cones, coaches and clinicians can assess movement quality, monitor performance, guide rehab, and reduce injury risk at scale.

records.name: Spacely AI
records.tagline: AI room rendering for interior design teams
records.description: Spacely AI turns sketches, room photos, and 3D concepts into photorealistic interior renders, then lets designers revise layouts, lighting, and furnishings in minutes.

records.name: Belli
records.tagline: Cargo management software for airlines
records.description: Belli builds cloud-native, API-first cargo software for airlines, covering load planning, air waybills, ULD management, customs, payments, and related ground operations. The team positions the product around complex airline cargo workflows and on-site implementation for carrier operations teams.

records.name: QuikBot Technologies
records.tagline: Autonomous delivery platform for last-mile logistics
records.description: QuikBot builds autonomous delivery robots and software for moving food, parcels, and other items around campuses and dense environments. The launch centers on robotics infrastructure more than a Product Hunt-style digital product.

records.name: Hoogly.ai
records.tagline: Turn employee voice into meaningful action using AI
records.description: Traditional engagement surveys are slow, generic, and rarely lead to action. Hoogly replaces them with confidential AI-powered conversations that transform employee voice into insights, coaching, and meaningful follow-through for leaders.

records.name: Tebahsoft Inc.
records.tagline: SEL AI platform for K-12 classrooms
records.description: Seamspace helps K-12 schools support student well-being with AI-powered journaling, emotional trend analysis, and teacher dashboards. It gives educators a clearer view of classroom emotions so they can respond earlier and build stronger social-emotional learning outcomes.

records.name: Respiree
records.tagline: Remote cardio-pulmonary care platform
records.description: Respiree builds a cardio-pulmonary remote care platform for continuous monitoring across healthcare settings. The site points to a regulated medtech product, but it still looks enterprise and device-led rather than a strong self-serve Product Hunt launch.

records.name: OpenJobs AI
records.tagline: End-to-End Autonomous AI Recruiter
records.description: Tell us what role you’re hiring for. AI recruiter sources qualified candidates, screens them against your requirements, sends personalized outreach, tracks replies, and books interviews directly on your calendar.

records.name: Greenmentor.co
records.tagline: ESG training and carbon management platform
records.description: Greenmentor combines ESG courses, sustainability services, and carbon management software for businesses working on reporting, emissions, and net-zero planning.

records.name: Zeya Health
records.tagline: AI clinic admin for WhatsApp and EMR
records.description: Zeya connects WhatsApp and clinic EMRs to automate bookings, reminders, rescheduling, follow-ups, and claims. It helps clinics cut front-desk workload, recover cancellations, and spot revenue gaps without changing existing workflows.

records.name: AIFORPET
records.tagline: AI pet health checks from simple phone clips
records.description: AIFORPET helps pet parents and care providers spot eye and skin issues from simple photos or video with TTcare. It extends the same AI health stack to clinics, equine care, and partner applications through dedicated tools and SDKs.

records.name: Pegasi
records.tagline: Control and govern AI agent actions
records.description: Pegasi is a runtime control layer for enterprise AI agents. It adds approvals, policy enforcement, observability, and audit trails so regulated teams can automate sensitive workflows without losing control.

records.name: Bookahospi
records.tagline: Degree recognition service for healthcare workers
records.description: Bookahospi helps healthcare professionals manage degree recognition and licensing paperwork across countries like Spain, the UAE, the UK, and France.

records.name: MyGigsters
records.tagline: Payments infrastructure for gig economy platforms
records.description: MyGigsters provides payout, onboarding, and financial infrastructure for gig platforms and freelancer marketplaces, helping operators manage contractor payments and benefits.

records.name: ClawSecure
records.tagline: The AI-Powered Antivirus for AI Agents
records.description: ClawSecure is the AI-powered antivirus for AI agents. Pre-install scanning, real-time runtime monitoring, an in-agent Security Companion Agent, and a sub-200ms Verification API. Full 10/10 OWASP ASI coverage. 41% of top agents are dangerous. Free, no signup. clawsecure.ai

records.name: VOXEA
records.tagline: Voice AI platform launching soon
records.description: VOXEA builds voice AI tools that help businesses automate conversations and handle customer interactions more efficiently. It is designed for teams that want always-on communication workflows powered by speech interfaces.

records.name: Ailytics
records.tagline: Vision Intelligence For Heavy Industries
records.description: Ailytics empowers heavy industries to enhance safety, productivity, and operational efficiency by transforming any existing camera infrastructure into an intelligent AI-driven system. Our cutting-edge platform delivers real-time, actionable insights, enabling smarter and faster decision making.

records.name: Living Roots
records.tagline: Biological crop programs for tropical farms
records.description: Living Roots sells stage-based biological crop programs for tropical agriculture, covering seed treatment, foliar nutrition, and soil recovery.

records.name: Lexarius
records.tagline: AI roleplays for corporate learning teams
records.description: Lexarius, co-developed with INSEAD and SC Ventures, is a multilingual AI roleplay platform that enables employees to practise sales, leadership, and change-management conversations in realistic simulations while receiving real-time feedback, immediate skill scoring, and competency-based assessment in a safe, scalable environment.
